title: "shuffle analysis"
output: pdf_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(TopKLists)
```

## Data import and merging

```{r, message=FALSE}
peter <- read_csv("Peter_wash_shuffle_data.csv")
sam <- read_csv("Sam_wash_shuffle_data.csv")
caleb <- read_csv("Caleb_wash_shuffle_data_combined.csv")
jordan <- read_csv("Jordan_wash_shuffle_data.csv")
seena <- read_csv("Seena_wash_shuffle_data.csv")

peter_wide <- peter %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c(name, sequence_id, trial_id),
              names_from=start_position,
              values_from=end_position)

sam_wide <- sam %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c(name, sequence_id, trial_id),
              names_from=start_position,
              values_from=end_position)

caleb_wide <- caleb %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c(name, sequence_id, trial_id),
              names_from=start_position,
              values_from=end_position)

jordan_wide <- jordan %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c(name, sequence_id, trial_id),
              names_from=start_position,
              values_from=end_position)

seena_wide <- seena %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c(name, sequence_id, trial_id),
              names_from=start_position,
              values_from=end_position)

```

## Graphs

### Where does the top card go?
```{r, fig.height=10}
ggplot(caleb, aes(x=end_position)) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  facet_wrap(~ start_position, ncol=5, scales="free") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size=8) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

ggplot(peter, aes(x=end_position)) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  facet_wrap(~ start_position, ncol=5, scales="free") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size=8) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

ggplot(sam, aes(x=end_position)) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  facet_wrap(~ start_position, ncol=5, scales="free") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size=8) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

```


## Footrule

### Unadjusted footrule calculations

```{r}
peter_fr <- NA
for(i in 1:dim(peter_wide)[1]){
  peter_fr[i] <- Spearman(1:52, as.numeric(as.vector(peter_wide[i,4:55])), 52, 52, 52)
}

sam_fr <- NA
for(i in 1:dim(sam_wide)[1]){
  sam_fr[i] <- Spearman(1:52, as.numeric(as.vector(sam_wide[i,4:55])), 52, 52, 52)
}


caleb_fr <- NA
for(i in 1:dim(caleb_wide)[1]){
  caleb_fr[i] <- Spearman(1:52, as.numeric(as.vector(caleb_wide[i,4:55])), 52, 52, 52)
}


jordan_fr <- NA
for(i in 1:dim(jordan_wide)[1]){
  jordan_fr[i] <- Spearman(1:52, as.numeric(as.vector(jordan_wide[i,4:55])), 52, 52, 52)
}


seena_fr <- NA
for(i in 1:dim(seena_wide)[1]){
  seena_fr[i] <- Spearman(1:52, as.numeric(as.vector(seena_wide[i,4:55])), 52, 52, 52)
}
```


Checking for temporal trend within each person:

```{r, fig.show='hold', fig.height=10}
par(mfrow=c(5, 1), mar=c(2, 4, 1, 1))

x <- 1:length(caleb_fr)
plot(caleb_fr ~ x, type='l')

x <- 1:length(jordan_fr)
plot(jordan_fr ~ x, type='l')

x <- 1:length(peter_fr)
plot(peter_fr ~ x, type='l')

x <- 1:length(sam_fr)
plot(sam_fr ~ x, type='l')

x <- 1:length(seena_fr)
plot(seena_fr ~ x, type='l')
```


Compare distributions via histograms:
```{r, fig.height=10}
par(mfrow=c(5, 1), mar=c(3, 4, 1, 1))

hist(caleb_fr, xlim=c(0, 1400))
hist(jordan_fr, xlim=c(0, 1400))
hist(peter_fr, xlim=c(0, 1400))
hist(sam_fr, xlim=c(0, 1400))
hist(seena_fr, xlim=c(0, 1400))
```

Pairwise K-S tests:

```{r}
ks_pvals <- matrix(NA, nrow=5, ncol=4)
rownames(matrix) <- c("Caleb", "Jordan", "Peter", "Sam", "Seena")
ks.test(caleb_fr, jordan_fr)$p.val
```
